# Salt & Ember

> A modern fire-led restaurant and steakhouse in Sylhet, Bangladesh where artisanal wood-fired cooking meets global culinary instincts.

## Restaurant Details
- **Name**: Salt & Ember
- **Tagline**: Flavour Meets Fire
- **Type**: Fire-led Steakhouse & Continental Restaurant
- **Location**: Baruthkhana Point, East Zindabazar, Sylhet 3100, Bangladesh
- **Geo Coordinates**: 24.8949° N, 91.8687° E
- **Map Destination**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/qBEyyTSasUwqyaRs5
- **Phone**: +880 1704 083 376
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/8801704083376
- **Social Media**:
  - Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/saltandember7
  - Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/salt.and.ember_

## Culinary Concept & Highlights
- **Hearth & Flame**: Authentic wood-fired grill and charcoal embers honoring seasonal marinades and artisanal smoke.
- **Cuisine**: Steaks, Continental, Wood-Fired Grill, Thai & Chinese, Seafood, Artisanal Burgers & Kebabs.
- **Atmosphere**: Modern, family-friendly, romantic dining, party and corporate event spaces.

## Menu & Experience
- **Heritage Menu**: Extensive multi-page artisanal menu available on-site and browsable at https://salt-ember.vercel.app/#menu
- **Key Categories**: Appetizers, Biriyani, Gourmet Burgers, Charcoal Kebabs, Fresh Pasta, Wood-Fired Pizza.
- **Chefs**:
  - Ashraf Al-Mansur (Executive Chef - Firecraft & Smoke Architecture)
  - Tariq Vance (Master of Flame - Charcoal & Slow Ember Roasting)
  - Elena Rostova (Pastry & Embers - Hearth Bakery & Charred Botanicals)
  - Marcus Chen (Sauce & Marinade Alchemist - Umami Glazes & Acid Balances)
